title: read a pictograph
seam: each row (its name and its symbols; the whole row is the target): data-row="<key>"
each symbol: data-symbol, inside its row; a row has exactly value / symbolValue symbols, all the same size
the key: data-key containing one symbol and the number symbolValue
brief: KIND: data visualisation. A pictograph: each symbol stands for Studio.params.symbolValue (shown in a key: one symbol = that number, with keytext).
CHART: one row per entry of Studio.params.rows: its name, then value / symbolValue identical symbols in a line, every row starting at the same x.
QUESTION: ask; the child taps a row -> Studio.answer("<key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict; on correct Studio.done() and the done text.
All rows look the same before the answer.
antiPatterns: symbols scaled to fit the row (they must all be one size)
a symbol count off by one
